# Recorded by RogueSquadron64Recomp-web's tools/shader_plan.json with N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs, in
# headless Chrome, on a build in 4:3 and again (--add) on one in widescreen, the page's default: section 0 is the boot
# (the launcher, the intro, SELECT GAME, ENTER NAME and AVAILABLE CRAFT, each press repeated until the screen word at
# 0x800CDAC4 moves), then a section a mission of the sixteen, set at AVAILABLE CRAFT as the port's own --boot-target
# level:N does: A on the craft, its chapter's crawl for the first of each chapter, its opening cinematic and about 25 s
# of flying, with blasters, a missile and the pause menu. Not played: the three bonus missions, the options, the
# passcodes, a mission's end and its debriefing; a shader they need that the list lacks draws with the ubershader in
# Chrome until it is built behind the game, and in Firefox it is built before the next frame and remembered for the next
# visit.
